name: Solara Active Pharma Sciences Ltd
title: Solara Active Pharma Sciences Ltd - 541540 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 12% QoQ to INR392 cr and EBITDA up 65% QoQ to INR61 cr, with base business at about 70% utilisation and ibuprofen under strategic review with negative EBITDA.

utilisation.quote: we are currently using around 70% of our capacity

capex.quote: There's no big capex that we're going to invest.

triggers.label: Capacity utilisation ~70%, ~30% spare
triggers.quote: we are currently using around 70% of our capacity. So, there is enough capacity

triggers.label: No greenfield or big capex planned
triggers.quote: we are not planning to take up any greenfield projects. There's no big capex that we're going to invest.

triggers.label: Ibuprofen strategic review via bankers
triggers.quote: Our Board has appointed bankers to evaluate strategic options for ibuprofen

triggers.label: No FY27/FY28 outlook given
triggers.quote: We will not give any outlook at this point.

triggers.label: Ibuprofen price upticks not yet in numbers
triggers.quote: we didn't have that incremental, like price shifts coming into these numbers

guidance.quote: We have been maintaining that we will be cl ose to in the range of 25% plus, minus here and

guidance.value: debt to about INR503 cr by end May 2026
guidance.quote: we have a line of sight to reduce the debt to close to INR503-odd crores by end of May '26
we expect this process to finish in the next 2 quarters
we have an internal target of making Solara debt-free by FY '29
we have a plan to do four to five DMF filings every year to start

prior_guidance_check.metric: Vizag plant commercial production in 5-6 months
prior_guidance_check.quote: we will have to give us time till H1 by when we will have a clear road map of exactly what we do with Vizag

red_flags.label: Ibuprofen negative EBITDA, under strategic review
red_flags.quote: On Ibuprofen, we continue to face persistent headwinds in this business where we recorded a negative EBITDA.

red_flags.label: Vizag plant mothballed since 2024, fixed cost INR12-15 cr/yr
red_flags.quote: we have certain fixed cost expenditure for the Vizag site which is INR12 crores to INR15 crores annually.

red_flags.label: Vizag restart timeline pushed out
red_flags.quote: you will have to give us time till H1 by when we will have a clear road map of exactly what we do with Vizag

red_flags.label: Zero R&D new filings in 4 years
red_flags.quote: our R&D engine has not been able to come up with at least one new product filing in the last 4 years

evasions.quote: No, Harshit. We will not give any outlook at this point.
